target.role: Private Asset Market Risk Modeler, Vice President, Aladdin Financial Engineering

summary: Candidate for Private Asset Market Risk Modeler, Vice President, Aladdin Financial Engineering — a quantitative risk practitioner with ~7 years across risk model development, statistical modeling, and portfolio analytics for institutional portfolios. Holds delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs ($5–25bn per engagement); built an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine and production Python pipelines; member of the model governance committee supporting client-facing model validations. Monte Carlo scenario modeling and VaR/CVaR optimization at Ortec Finance. CFA; dual MSc.

sections.heading: Model Development & Quantitative Analytics
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across portfolio horizons.

Architected configurable time-bucketed exposure and liquidity analytics (T+1 through multi-year); oversaw interest-rate and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel shocks, translating quantitative outputs into decision-ready risk reports.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, data quality and validation controls — in production across the modelling team, version-controlled in Git.

sections.heading: Model Governance, Validation & Client Communication
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement, cumulatively covering ~$50bn of client assets.

Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation for fixed income and cross-asset mandates — review curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release; escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility.

Member of the model governance committee — methodology review and challenge, documentation and benchmarking standards, model-performance assessment, and support of model validations for external clients including pension funds and asset managers.

sections.heading: AI/ML Tooling & Automation
bullets: Built agentic AI development workflows leveraging LLMs (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) — automating code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation; reduced development cycle time ~30–40% on comparable modules.

Led onboarding and implementation of PFaroe DB and PFaroe PM — vendor risk and analytics platforms competing in the Aladdin space — for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms.

Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product/development functions — translated analytical requirements into testable documentation, and validated model implementations post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — aligned liability measurement and reporting frameworks with system implementation, model controls, and governance documentation.

Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators (Monte Carlo) assessing interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk under base and stressed environments; performed hedging analysis across rates, inflation, and FX.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization based on VaR and CVaR on Ortec's GLASS platform; conducted risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk, and near-optimal frontier robustness analysis.
Delivered ALM and portfolio analytics studies for Canadian and international pension funds — modelled actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment-product types and economic variables.

Presented quantitative findings to investment committees at pension-fund clients; led onboarding and the ALM study for the University Pension Plan (UPP) three-plan merger, developing and validating the model evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
